acceptedMainMeaning: Explicit recovery checkpoint; not S06 acceptance
authorizedScope: State/authority registration and guard-checked work backup only; product remains unchanged while independent review starts.
requestedAction: Same original writer registers this run as accepted engineering-decision reference in existing decisionReferences with exact receipt hash, and implementationBaseline.decisionReferenceIds. Keep actual I/build and active S06 unchanged; no acceptedEvidence/completion/gate edits. Add concise current routing note to README if needed so historical Human-first wording is clearly superseded by this run. Atomic validate state; commit explicit authorized files/evidence with B00 identification and normally push work after rereading remote main/work. Preserve production/debug.log. Return commit, remote confirmation, state hash and STOP_WRITING.
exclusions: No product change before B00 review result
evidenceRequirements: One compact registration receipt, exact commit/push state; no full runtime replay for metadata registration
stopConditions: After guarded commit/push and receipt stop writing pending bounded next assignment
Unexpected refs or writer conflict: preserve, report, reconcile
nextRoute: Coordinator collects registered authority and review result; no Human gate
